activities.name: Plane Shift
activities.note: Two modes. (1) Transport: you and up to eight willing creatures linked by hand (or yourself alone) travel to another plane. (2) Banish: with a melee spell attack against one unwilling creature, succeed and force a CHA save (DC = spell save); on a failed save the target is banished to another plane (no return without aid). v0 cannot model planar shifts — surfaces as a note only.
